authority.reason: The repository owner controls dependency and environment policy.

choices.summary: Move optional ML imports behind an explicit runtime boundary.

tradeoffs.maintainability: Keeps optional dependencies out of unrelated paths.
tradeoffs.quality: Preserves real UI proof without replacing the production path.
tradeoffs.reversibility: Can be reverted as one bounded adapter change.
tradeoffs.risk: Requires care to preserve existing ML behavior.
tradeoffs.scope: One import boundary and focused regression coverage.

choices.summary: Install the complete ML dependency stack in every test environment.

tradeoffs.maintainability: Couples all test paths to a platform-specific stack.
tradeoffs.quality: Exercises the production import path directly.
tradeoffs.reversibility: Dependency changes can be rolled back.
tradeoffs.risk: May hide an unnecessary eager-import dependency.

decision_context.question: How should optional ML imports be isolated for real UI proof?

expected_result.threshold: Zero unrelated import failures in the focused UI proof run.

recommendation.principal_uncertainty: Whether any production entry point still imports the ML stack eagerly.
revisit_when: The ML stack becomes a required dependency for every application entry point.
recommendation.why: It removes the unrelated import failure at the narrowest durable seam.
